The '''Modus system''' was located in the [[Rifle Worlds]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Rynmar Trail]] to the [[Vergill system/Legends|Vergill system]] of the Rifle Worlds and to the [[Sargon system/Legends|Sargon system]] in the [[Gateworlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Modus [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturing company [[Modan]].<ref name="CSWE Modan">{{CSWECite|II|322|Modan}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Modus system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
